An ISO timestamp indicating the date and time when the rule was
last updated.
string <date-time>
An ISO timestamp indicating the date and time when the rule was
last processed.
string
The description of the rule.
string
Enum: "HOST"
"HOST_AUDIT"
"WEBAPP"
The type of findings the rule targets.
AND (OPTION 1) (object) or OR (OPTION 2) (object)
Filter rules based on the targeted vulnerabilities. Use the and  array
to combine multiple conditions that all must be true. Use the or
array to combine multiple conditions where at least one must be true.
string <date-time>
Optional date and time indicating when the rule will expire. It has to
be an ISO timestamp. If no expiry date is specified, the rule is set to
never expire.
object
Details about a rule when it is disabled.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters, if your request was improperly formatted, or if
you attempted to create a duplicate rule.
401 Returned if the API keys specified in your request are invalid.
